messages.subject: #5456 Suspended actor-control role packet (evidence only)
messages.body:
#5456 Suspended actor-control role packet (evidence only; no fix proposal, no code, no teleport, no primary-player fact; batch 4 susveh stays HOLD)

Dir: work/investigations/grok1/susrole/ (untracked, mine). Game Suspended.z3.js sha256 252462be2eb7efb4... (same in both trees).
Base = ..\wt-g1c4 @ ccd9b58 clean. Cand = ..\wt-g1sus-cand @ 70d77b4 + susveh facts diff only (M js/ModuleStatFactsClaude.js).
Probe: role-probe3.cjs (g1-batch + zvm call hook [unpackedAddr,args,ret,pc] + ram.setUint16 global-write hook [Gidx,val,pc]); state read at +400ms and again at +2900ms.

1) COMPILED SELECTOR (static + executed)
zdis-change-winner.txt = my disassembly of routine 25030 (packed 12515) from the story bytes; matches main.zil:69 CHANGE-WINNER line for line:
  25091 store #130,L0        -> G114 := OBJ          (SETG WINNER .OBJ)
  25094 store #71,#0         -> G55  := 0            (SETG OLD-WINNER <>)
  25097 get_parent L0 -> L2; jin L2,#189(ROOMS) ? L2 : parent(L2)
  25113 store #212,sp        -> G196 := room          (SETG WINNER-HERE ...)
  25116 get_prop G114,#7 -> G54                       (SETG ROFF <GETP WINNER P?ROBOT>)
  25120 store #16,G114       -> G0   := WINNER        (SETG HERE ,WINNER  -- HERE holds the ROBOT object, not a room)
Executed: every link fires call 25030 with the robot as arg 0 and writes G114=robot@25091, G55=0@25091, G0=robot@25113:
  sensa link (step 0) 25030(152)@40653; poet link (step 10) 25030(146)@40644; sensa relink (step 38) 25030(152); iris (group run step 10) 25030(158).
  "already established" path: 25037 je L0,G114 -> no stores (steps 3,16,18,21).
Selector = global var 130 (globals+2*114) = WINNER, persistent across turns (G114 unchanged by bare look/wait/exit; bare commands act as it: step 19/22 bare "look" prints Poet's room).
Other globals tied in source: G196 WINNER-HERE, G55 OLD-WINNER (also rewritten each turn @26624 / parser :160 @40644), G54 ROFF, G192 CAR-FULL, G47 DEADBOTS, ROOMS=189, HALL-END=103, CAR-AREA=86.

2) TWO ROBOTS / GROUP
Natural: Sensa 152 and Poet 146 both start in 151 Central Chamber.
- POS dual (group-base.json step 3) "both sensa and poet,look": "FC: Dual-Cryolink established to Sensa and Poet." G114:=142 (TWOBOTS, "Two Robots", ROBOT 0) @25691 = main.zil SETG WINNER ,TWOBOTS -> no singular actor; TWOBOTS-FCN refuses LOOK ("Using two robots will not help accomplish that task."), then 25030(152)@45962 relinks Sensa; end WINNER 152.
- NEG different places (groupneg-base.json steps 4,6, sensa@138 poet@151): "FC: The robots are in different places." no G114 write, no 25030 call; WINNER stays 152 and the command re-runs as Sensa.
- NEG/contrast sequential "sensa and poet,look" (no BOTH; role3 step 23) and "...,look together" (role3 steps 25,36): NOT the group path (TOGETHER after the comma is in P-CONT; P-TWOBOTS is reset per PARSER call). Runs Sensa then Poet: 25030(152) then 25030(146)@27400; end WINNER 146.

3) VEHICLE ROUTE (role3-base / role3-cand, identical native values)
step | cmd | poet par | car(58) par | G0/G55/G114/G192 | G196
17 wait (outside)      | 103 | 103 | 146/146/146/0   | 103
18 poet,get in car     | 58  | 86  | 146/146/146/146 | 103->86  ("I am now in the carriage... External map reference -- Vehicle Debarkation Area"; V-BOARD moves CAR to new WINNER-HERE: ride is instant, CAR-FULL:=WINNER @37332)
19 look (inside, bare) | 58  | 86  | same            | 86 (Poet's "Inside the carriage")
20 exit (bare)         | 58  | 86  | unchanged; no stores | "An unlikely request, considering where I am." (V-EXIT = DO-WALK OUT) = NEGATIVE
21 poet,get out of car | 86  | 86  | 146/146/146/0   | 86   ("I am on my mobile extensions again." V-DISEMBARK MOVE WINNER WINNER-HERE, CAR-FULL 0) = POSITIVE
22 look                | 86  | 86  | same            | Vehicle Debarkation Area

4) ACTUAL WRAPPER pool/room/player (late read; same both trees)
resolvePlayer = {id 0, source none} at every step, playerId null always (no player global supplied; matches your sealed ZRamReader:2164 finding).
lastPayload.roomId tracks WINNER's room only sometimes: boot room=158 'Iris' (= G0 HERE, a robot object); 17 -> 103 Hallway End; 18-20 -> 58 'vehicle' (the car itself); 21 -> 41 'storage cabinet' (wrong; poet at 86); 22 -> 86; 25 -> 50 'groove'; 36 -> 76 'BASKET'; 37 -> 74 'first socket'; group runs: poet-linked at 151 -> 50 'groove', sensa-linked at 151 -> 151. Wrong rooms persist at +2.9s, so not just lag.
ActionSynth.commandsForPayloadObjectId(58,'room'):
  base: 17/22 outside -> ["examine contai"]; inside 18-20 -> [] 
  cand: 17/22 outside -> ["examine contai","enter contai","exit contai"]; inside 18-20 -> []  (strings verbatim as returned)
So the cand only adds offers when the wrapper room equals the car's room; nothing is offered while inside (room=58), and its "exit" string would be the bare-exit NEGATIVE of step 20 anyway; the native positive needs the actor-addressed disembark.

Artifacts (sha256 prefix): role3-base.json 58F2E14D59AFDB41, role3-cand.json FDD7BEC6841D30B7, group-base.json 36D2ABABD1806B25, groupneg-base.json 4BCD01A8B2A00C80, zdis-change-winner.txt F896E25549AE68F4, routes-role2.json E0CC035E30089932, routes-group.json 06E2B13AA27260EF, routes-groupneg.json 01C338FF2A0E3180, role-probe3.cjs 66BAE5FDBC73247E.
Ask: is this the evidence bar you wanted for #5456? I will not propose a shared fix until you rule. Still waiting on your #5457 regen verdict.
